hypothesis: A rank-ordered bit-parallel consistency mask can reproduce every source-blind WSP137 active intervention, confidence decision and learned state while overcoming WSP138's failed speed target. A positive is ENGINEERING efficiency only, not scientific learning or operator invention.

source.forbidden: all other seeds including 206800..206863,207800..207863,208800..208863,209800..209863, historical scored 202xxx..205xxx (WSP138), 210xxx..214xxx (WSP139), and sealed original benchmark source
source.source_function: same six-input source-only gates, seeded SHA256 under fresh WSP140 labels, permuted Boolean inputs, known 2gate then terminal XOR private sixth factor, unfamiliar majority XOR singleton, off-family cross products
source.public_action_pool: exact WSP137 public 48 legal x, excluding 16 matched public query locations
source.held_queries: all 64 typed inputs checked for output equality, 16 held common and 32 arm-specific held; predictions frozen before scoring
source.evaluation: One source custodian query ONLY after both arms choose identical x; share same public effect/receipt once; do not permit second query, uncertain replay or native admission.

mechanism.unchanged_baseline: Exact WSP137 ActivePolicy, DirectArm, 17640 generic two-pair template bank, SHA256 hypothesis rank, first4 fixed, next28 active. Final WSP135 fit/readout and receipt/snapshot code unchanged.
mechanism.candidate: Global source-independent mask at each x in 0..63 and each of 16 latent codes: bit r is 1 iff rank-r template maps x to that code. Masks indexed in WSP137 SHA256 order and built once using 64x16 bytearray buffers and int.from_bytes little-endian. On each public outcome (x,y), for each prior opposite-labeled public x' eliminate bitset of all hypotheses mapping x and x' to same code: OR_{c=0..15}(mask[x,c]&mask[x',c]). Live set is bitset ALL AND NOT invalid; use low-set-bit enumeration for first256 active survivors in identical SHA rank. For selected survivor only, reconstruct 16-code seen output from original received public observations, then original vote/unknown and lexicographic tie-break. Fallback same original WSP137 if none. No source oracle, true law/seed or future labels in policy.
mechanism.baseline_independent: Original WSP137 source and algorithm unchanged in ancestor; WSP138 lazy NO_GO code remains untouched and not used as comparator.
mechanism.canonical_snapshot: Subclasses original DirectArm and overrides transient chooser ONLY; stored trained facts, actions and canonical snapshot bytes must be byte-identical; cold restore replays real paid-public event history deterministically.
mechanism.precomputation: Immutable masks and original 17640 template/rank codebooks are source-independent. Both arms may warm original shared hypothesis bank/rank before timer. Cost of first mask allocation and conversion MUST be included in optimized choose time and in peak memory; subsequent masks reused across all worlds and cold restore. Report actual cache bytes separately and add cache bytes once to optimized per-world mutable state accounting.
mechanism.same_information_controls: Independently coded WSP137 symbolic 17640 codebooks (not model internals) must match outputs exactly, fully trained depth6 CART same effects, strong 7062 supplied source-grammar oracle only for context, no-update.

thresholds.first_gate: 1,024/1,024 public chosen actions equal before effect, all 64 output predictions/world equal, full stored learned fact snapshot SHA identical, exactly same source/knowledge receipt, all source guards and cold replay, 384/384 zero-effect relabel readouts, no known-world drift, 0 protected first-use.
thresholds.full_model_measurement: Choose+observe+final fit/readout+snapshot+cold restore, source/evaluator/control excluded from per-arm cost; account for global source-independent mask initialization once, include it within first optimized choose. Alternate original vs optimized arm call order. Warm original shared source-independent candidate templates+rank both arms before trial clocks.
thresholds.resource_report: Report wall and process CPU per arm, peak tracemalloc for whole experiment and measured structural allocation bytes; distinguish RSS/energy not verified.
thresholds.accepted_results: DEVELOPMENT_BITPARALLEL_COST_SUPPORTED only if all frozen gates PASS on EACH Linux & Windows. Else DEVELOPMENT_BITPARALLEL_COST_NO_GO; preserve immutable negative independent of engineering full regression. Even PASS is no SCIENTIFIC_PASS or native model improvement.
